# A supply balloon: an 8-gore envelope (Gold and Canvas stripes), 1.1 m across and 1.27 m tall, a skirt and a wicker basket with a supply crate. Pivot at the envelope's centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Canvas --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
material new Gold --base-color 0.937 0.675 0.157 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot
material new Wicker --base-color 0.447 0.255 0.075 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Env --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 1.15
apply --scale
select Env
active Env
material assign Canvas
mode edit
select face where "pos.x > 0 && pos.y >= 0 && pos.y < pos.x"
select face where "pos.x <= 0 && pos.y > 0 && -pos.x < pos.y" --extend
select face where "pos.x < 0 && pos.y <= 0 && pos.y > pos.x" --extend
select face where "pos.y < 0 && pos.x >= 0 && pos.x < -pos.y" --extend
material assign Gold
mode object
add mesh cone --name Skirt --vertices 8 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0.26 --depth 0.24 --location 0 0 -0.66
material assign Canvas
add mesh cube --name Basket1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.930
scale 0.320 0.320 0.240
apply --scale
select Basket1
material assign Wicker
add mesh cube --name Crate2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -1.150
scale 0.260 0.260 0.200
apply --scale
select Crate2
material assign Dark
select all
shade flat
export supply.glb
